$description: Mode-less SYSTEM tokens (type, radius, size) and the COMPONENT exceptions that are not colours. Same value in light and dark.

body.$description: IBM Plex Sans throughout (0500) — the crossbarred capital I (0492). Self-hosted (aincient_chat/fonts, aincient_core/fonts).

display.$description: Headings use the same face at weight 500 with tight tracking; Fraunces is retired from the app (0500).

mono.$description: Machine text only — ids, tokens, addresses, paths in a well chip (Law 13). Never eyebrows or panel heads (0500).

radius.$description: Square (0500): everything that belongs to the page has 0 radius. The names stay so a theme can round them.

column-max.$description: The reading column — chat and forms never grow wider.

height.$description: The top bar's height — the WIP-list drawer and its scrim start below it. Tracks .ain-topbar's 30px control + 10px×2 padding + 1px border.
Shared height of every panel head (chat / preview / rail) so the column heads line up flush.

mark.$description: The brand mark's spectrum chip — the ONLY place the four vivid bands appear (Law 01).

pigment.$description: The stripe of the Atelier CMS mark — the only cinnabar in the app (0501).
